input.title: Bluewater Freight - fleet reporting kickoff
input.summary: Bluewater Freight described a weekly fleet report that takes two people most of Monday. The group agreed that the first milestone is an automated weekly report. Dashboards were deferred until the report runs on its own. Running the old spreadsheet in parallel was raised and not settled.
decisions: The first milestone is an automated weekly report; dashboards wait until it runs on its own.

actionItems.quote: I'll send over the data access checklist by Thursday.

actionItems.task: Export last quarter's dispatch data and share it
actionItems.quote: I can export last quarter's dispatch data and share it by October 13.

actionItems.task: Book a session with the IT lead for read access
actionItems.quote: I will book a session with our IT lead so you can get read access to the dispatch database.

actionItems.task: Write a one-page cost estimate for the reporting work
actionItems.quote: I'll put together a one-page cost estimate for the reporting work.

openQuestions: Does the old spreadsheet need to run in parallel for a month?

followUp.subject: Fleet reporting: next steps
followUp.body:
Hi Tomas and Ines,

Thanks for the time today. We agreed that the first milestone is an automated weekly report, and that dashboards wait until it runs on its own.

From our side: the data access checklist by Thursday and a one-page cost estimate.

Still open: whether the old spreadsheet needs to run in parallel for a month.

Best,
Jordan
